expectation_method: Assembler resolves authored symbolic addresses only; paths, events, and per-instruction active frame lists are fixed by the case author, never interpreted from opcodes.
producer_adjustment_contract: One shared registration slot per SUB or GOTO in source PC order. SUB writes its PC and retains that slot index as ID; GOTO consumes a raw unused hole word without an ID. Hole words are fixed by the fixture author and are never interpreted as targets.
